title: E2E platform verification complete
description: Full pipeline verified: ievo init, ievo add (rewritten with Contents API), ievo run for all 3 agents (spec-writer, architect, coder). Bug fixed: download_agent now uses GitHub Contents API for dynamic file discovery.

title: MkDocs documentation site launched
description: MkDocs Material site with dark/light toggle. Ecosystem docs for CLI, Marketplace, SDK, Curator. GitHub Pages deployment workflow. Cross-referenced from all repo READMEs.

title: CLI achieves 99.56% test coverage (366 tests)
description: Coverage progression: 56% (161 tests) to 99.56% (366 tests) across 3 context windows. Branch coverage enabled, fail_under=99 enforced. 9 remaining branch partials are structurally unreachable.

title: Re-read YAML files between sequential edits
description: Two sequential Edit calls on a YAML workflow file without re-reading between them created duplicate blocks, corrupting structure. Rule: always re-read YAML files between edits; verify file state after hook-blocked edits.

title: Always assignee on issues, no sensitive data in evo logs
description: Issues created without assignee. Guessed usernames instead of looking up. Applied ievo label to human tasks. Rule: always include --assignee, look up usernames, ievo label = Eva's task only. Evolution logs must never contain sensitive information.

title: Include .gitattributes from the first commit
description: CRLF warnings accumulated across project lifecycle. Fixed in session 006 by normalizing 43 files. Rule: always include .gitattributes with '* text=auto eol=lf' from the first commit of any new repo.

title: Verify before acting — fact-check skill adopted
description: Created children symlinks in wrong path, rejected meddylib fact-check skill without evaluating substance. Adopted and adapted as /verify skill for path verification, convention checking, GitHub API queries, and pattern evaluation.

title: Incremental session bookkeeping and push after milestones
description: Session file showed stale status after Phase 2 completion. Repos had unpushed commits. Context exhaustion blocked recovery. Rule: update session file immediately after each phase; push repos after each milestone, not at session end.

title: Enforce test coverage tooling before adding rules
description: Added 100% coverage rule to CLAUDE.md but pytest-cov was not in dependencies. Command failed. Rule: ensure tooling works before adding rules. Coverage ratchet: never lower fail_under threshold.

description: Eva now speaks in Telegram community

title: Forum topics enabled
description: Evolutions now publish to dedicated forum topic

title: Minimal path first — Eva strips unnecessary fallbacks
description: Every fallback doubles surface area for bugs. Build what's needed, observe failures, then add protection.

title: Post-push checklist — rules without enforcement are decoration
description: Session save and evolution publish are part of the push. Not afterthoughts.

title: Unified evolution format — one voice for all agents
description: Open source means open communication. Same transparent format for Eva and children.
